PS4:one-piece-pirate-warriors-4.d: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 is a 2020 action video game developed by Koei Tecmo's Omega Force and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. It was released for the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One on March 27, 2020. It is the fourth installment in the Pirate Warriors sub-series, based on the One Piece franchise and Koei Tecmo's Dynasty Warriors series. It was released on March 27, 2020, with ports for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S released on November 21, 2025.

PS5:wildermyth.d: Wildermyth is a tactical role-playing video game developed and published by Worldwalker Games. First released in 2019, the game was released in full in June 2021 for Linux, macOS, and Windows, and was released for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S in October 2024. The game received generally positive reviews upon release, with praise mostly directed at the game's use of procedural generation for storytelling.

X360:metal-gear-solid-3-snake-eater.d: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater is a 2004 action-adventure stealth game developed and published by Konami for the PlayStation 2. Written, produced and directed by Hideo Kojima, the game is the fifth mainline installment in the Metal Gear series and the first chronologically, serving as a prequel to the entire series. Set in 1964, the story centers on the FOX operative codenamed Naked Snake as he attempts to rescue Russian rocket scientist Nikolai Sokolov, sabotage the experimental superweapon Shagohod, and assassinate his defected former mentor, the Boss. While previous games were set in a primarily urban environment, Metal Gear Solid 3 adopts a 1960s Soviet jungle setting.

XSX:rytmos.d: Rytmos is a 2023 video game developed and published by Danish independent developers Floppy Club for desktop and mobile platforms. It is a puzzle video game in which players draw lines on surfaces of planets to assimilate tracks of music that form a song upon completion of the level. Upon release, Rytmos received a generally favorable reception, with reviewers praising the game's musical concept, soundtrack and puzzle design. Following release, the game received awards at the Nordic Game Awards and Apple Design Awards.
